name: Debug
description: Codex and Claude diagnose a defect independently, converge on the cause, implement the fix, and model-review the result. Verification here is a second model review, not a controller-owned check.

steps.name: Diagnose independently
steps.promptTemplate:
Diagnose the reported defect from the current repository and supplied evidence. Identify the reproducible cause before proposing changes.

{{userPrompt}}

steps.name: Converge on root cause
steps.promptTemplate:
Cross-reference the other diagnosis against repository evidence. Return JSON only with candidate, accepted, objections, and unresolvedRisks. candidate must be {"findings":[...]}. Each finding needs stable id, subject, message, explicit disposition accepted/rejected/unresolved, evidence and challenges string arrays, optional severity error/warning/information, and optional location with file/startLine/endLine. accepted is boolean for this exact candidate. Keep proposed claims out of accepted findings.

{{peerAnswersTagged}}

steps.name: Implement the fix
steps.promptTemplate: Implement the agreed root-cause fix and verify the relevant behavior.

steps.name: Model-review the fix
steps.promptTemplate:
Inspect the current repository and the other participant's answer. Verify the fix against repository evidence. Return JSON only with candidate, accepted, objections, and unresolvedRisks. candidate must be {"findings":[...]}. Each finding needs stable id, subject, message, explicit disposition accepted/rejected/unresolved, evidence and challenges string arrays, optional severity error/warning/information, and optional location with file/startLine/endLine. accepted is boolean for this exact candidate. Keep proposed claims out of accepted findings.

{{peerAnswersTagged}}
